question: Can the landing explain engineering and operation with verified product evidence while keeping its editing demo simple?
hypothesis: A role-based narrative backed by live Saturn IDE/runtime surfaces can demonstrate the product directly, while authenticated server scenarios remain CI evidence instead of marketing screenshots.
evidencePlan: Existing release tests retain two-way editing, routing during drag, undo/reset, storage isolation and full IDE handoff
Authenticated engineer publishes a project; a separate operator session opens the same applied revision after the engineer disconnects
On the small example, operate the pump, observe low flow, acknowledge the active warning and restore the setpoint; downloadable source must match exactly
Embed the real Saturn IDE in shell-only mode and the built public runtime demo instead of displaying generated screenshots
Keep light/dark product screenshots only as CI regression evidence, not public landing content
Check native keyboard surface selection, local links and no horizontal overflow at 320/390/768px

negativeKnowledge.hypothesis: A marketing reconstruction is sufficient evidence of the operator experience
negativeKnowledge.condition: It would not establish that the authenticated Saturn runtime provides the shown UI

negativeKnowledge.hypothesis: A supported protocol name proves compatibility with arbitrary equipment
negativeKnowledge.condition: An equipment-specific adapter and bench validation are still required

negativeKnowledge.hypothesis: An entire multi-system training installation is a useful first operator screenshot
negativeKnowledge.condition: The full-plant fit makes equipment and operational details too small; use a bounded, executable pump example instead

negativeKnowledge.hypothesis: CI screenshots should double as public product UI
negativeKnowledge.condition: Static evidence ages visually and makes the landing look reconstructed; the browser can run the actual product surfaces instead

decision: candidate: live IDE/runtime landing surfaces; browser verification on existing release CI
validity: Product communication and authenticated server simulation only; no physical PLC, availability or field reliability claims. Local source retrieval used the matching Pages artifact and connector reads because the container could not resolve GitHub. The required npx usegit context attempt exited 128; no lease or work state is claimed.
